==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Visit [[Gwen's garden|Gwen's Garden]].
*Visit [[Drakkar]] Lake.
*Visit the [[Shrine of the Bear Spirit]] {{sic|Missing period}}
*Visit the [[Kralkatorrik|strange ridge]] in [[Dalada Uplands]].
*Visit the [[burning forest]] in [[Sacnoth Valley]].
*Visit the [[G.O.L.E.M. site|G.O.L.E.M site]]. {{sic|missing period after M}}
*Visit the [[Bloodstone Caves|Shiverpeak bloodstone]]. Note: Take the "Crystal Method" quest from Saerin in Gadd's Encampment
*Visit [[Ventari's sanctuary]].
*See [[Festival Enthusiast Styr Wolf-Handed]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,007 [[Experience]]
*2,012 [[Gold]]
*[[Proof of Mountains]]

==Walkthrough==
*Primary quests cannot be used, you must go to their "natural" instance.
**To complete the Shiverpeak bloodstone objective, you must accept the [[Crystal Method]] secondary quest from [[Saerin]] in [[Gadd's Encampment]] and enter the dungeon through the [[portal]] (''not'' by activating the [[Inscription Stone]], the [[Finding the Bloodstone]] primary quest will not give you credit, so make sure [[Gadd]] and [[Livia]] are not present as allies).

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Festival Enthusiast Styr Wolf-Handed'''
:''"This human celebration, the Wayfarer's Reverie, appeals to me as a fellow adventurer. Travel is conquest! To visit the entirety of the world, unflinching before all dangers, that is the legend of a true slayer.''

:''Feeling the stirring of glory in your soul? Prove yourself the equal of a [[Norn]] by journeying across these lands and defeating all [[foe]]s that block your road!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll show you I'm your equal and more; there's no greater adventurer than I.
|decline = This sounds a little violent for a festival. I'll pass.
|ask = North, south, east and west! Prove to me that there is no foe capable of barring your path!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Festival Enthusiast Styr Wolf-Handed'''
:''"Even here, I have heard the tales of your bravery. Journeying the breadth of these lands, you are undefeated in all directions!''

:''As a trophy to prove your might, take these tokens, and let no Norn question that your heart holds the soul of a conqueror."''

== Notes ==
*Only one player [[character]] or [[hero]] in the [[party]] needs to arrive at the objective, which strongly encourages [[running]]. The runner does not need the quest to trigger the objective for other players.
** Unlike all other Wayfarer's Reverie-related landmarks, the Shiverpeak bloodstone cannot be visited through regular running, since the door at the end of the first level requires a dungeon key dropped by the [[Paranoia Ettin]].

== Trivia ==
*The rewards are a reference to the year ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]'' was released (2007) and the year ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' was released (2012).
